settings.title: Turn-by-turn on the cluster and HUD
CarPlay turns with no arrow
settings.description: A maneuver the cluster has no icon for, after the nearest one is tried (the start of a route, say). Clearing the turn or an empty turn shows the cluster's spinner and hides the distance.

options.title: Clear the turn from the cluster
Send an empty turn (can show a spinner)

settings.title: Android Auto turns in the car's own format (AR HUD arrow, distance bar)
settings.description: Near each maneuver (about 1,500 ft), Android Auto's turns go to the cluster and HUD as the car's own navigation sends them: turn, U-turn, fork, exit and roundabout types with their angle and the distance bar counting down, which the AR HUD animates; destinations as left, right or ahead. Off: the projection icons, as before. Checked on a US Ioniq 5 with the AR HUD. Takes effect when the head unit restarts.

settings.title: Wireless CarPlay (Bluetooth bridge and Wi-Fi sessions)
Restart wireless CarPlay when it doesn't come back
settings.description: When a wireless session ends while the iPhone is still connected over Bluetooth and the phone doesn't start it again, the car redoes the Bluetooth handshake (up to 5 times, waiting longer each time). Never during a call, a running session or USB CarPlay, or while the head unit's Wi-Fi is joined to a network (its hotspot is off then). A phone that hasn't used wireless CarPlay here yet (its first setup) is left alone.

settings.title: CarPlay music and Siri over Wi-Fi (AAC, Opus)
CarPlay picture recovers from a freeze
settings.description: A hook in the CarPlay app (no files changed). When the video decoder reports a failure or the screen stream times out, asks the phone for a new full frame, as leaving CarPlay and coming back does, without the flicker.

settings.title: On wireless CarPlay, also ask for a full frame regularly
settings.description: For a picture that freezes without the decoder reporting it. Caps a freeze at the interval below, for one extra full frame each time.

settings.title: Full frame interval
settings.description: How often the regular full frame is asked for. node-CarPlay uses 5 seconds.

settings.title: Settings > Phone Projection opens Device Connections
settings.description: A hook in the Settings app (no files changed). US/Canada only; other regions keep the stock choice.

settings.title: USB drives and hubs don't start wired Android Auto
settings.description: A hook in the Android Auto app (no files changed). Without it, a USB drive can block wireless Android Auto until the head unit restarts.

settings.title: Diagnostic log (test builds)
settings.description: Keeps a log of the CarPlay app and the unit in the CarPlay app's data folder, 32 MB at most, only with 200 MB free. For bug reports; turn it off and delete the folder afterwards.
